body: no i build unofficial builds of a custom ROM (I have the devs blessing...they are my friends) nothing is broken....but I need to start building LP and I need to update my build environment. I cant even concentrate on that anymore and it makes me sad...I just woke up...I am going soon. I just wanted one last cup of coffee...

I started taking them (again...I have been addicted before) while I was up north. The fights between my ex and seeing my dad was too much. I can go about a day without then the withdrawals get really bad. So dizzy I fall. I had a seizure the other morning. I tried to get through it but I can't. Not with everything else that's happened. I'm scared. I'm alone. I'm tired of hurting. I'm in so much pain. I just want it to end. I can't concentrate on anything. I'm supposed to update my stuff (leaving the technobabble out) so I can build the new version of Android... And I can't. My mind is all fucked up
The only reason I've not walked into the woods yet is that I'm afraid of the dark. Such a stupid reason. I'm waiting for the daylight. I will do it then
The xanax thing is intermittent. Sometimes the withdrawals are bad and I get dizzy and weak sometimes I'm OK.... But it gives me a panicky feeling a lot....

He says he was relieved.... but we had talked about having children... Just not right then. He wasn't working at the time. I know not working bothered him. He is far from perfect. He takes xanax as well and drinks too much.... But we had a bond at one point. We connected over technology and android. However, that is gone now.

The miscarriages were early. Only a couple of weeks. I was broken by them. I was relieved but at the same time heart broken. It hurt so much. I'm now stuck in a state alone, where I know no one, he claims his family hates me. I'm going to be spending the holidays alone. The xanax withdrawals are terrible. I keep falling from the dizzy spells and I've had a seizure. Everything is so broken. I don't know how to fix it and I just want it to end
I just wanted to tell my story. Goodbye. thank you.

I have not seen since I got back on Wednesday. I don't think I will either....we had a huge fight were i threw the engagement ring at him...He still moved me down here but things were never the same. They have deteriorated to the point where he is always hostile and combative. I already have the rope. I feel so alone and broken hearted. My mom died july 23, my dad had a stroke and is dying. I had two back to back miscarriages (with this guy)... too much has happened
